hints.content: To translate $\triangle ABC$ by $2$ units up, we basically translate $\triangle ABC$'s vertices and connect them.

For example, point $\blueD{A(6,-5)}$ is translated to $\greenD{(6,-3)}$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane with a triangle with vertices A B C and Vertex A at six, negative five, vertex B at negative two, four, and vertex C at negative seven, negative five. The x- and y- axes scale by one. A dashed line moves from vertex A two units up to a point at six, negative three.

hints.content:
Doing this for all vertices and connecting them, we get the following mapping:



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane with a triangle with vertices A B C and Vertex A at six, negative five, vertex B at negative two, four, and vertex C at negative seven, negative five. The x- and y- axes scale by one. A dashed line moves from the three vertices two units up to form the image of a congruent triangle with vertices at six, negative three, negative two, six, and negative seven, negative three.
